evidence_limit: Six synthetic conversations from one source; no causal or real-world success claim. Role-specific supporting judgment only.

principles.principle: When attention is limited, reduce buyer effort and establish concise relevance before requesting discovery.
principles.exceptions: A scheduled or unexpectedly engaged conversation can warrant depth; brevity alone does not create relevance.
principles.confidence: low empirical confidence; provisional support within this synthetic batch

principles.principle: Treat a problem hypothesis as revisable; respect low significance and consider a graceful exit when evidence does not justify pursuit.
principles.exceptions: Strong new evidence warrants pursuing the opportunity; this is not a bias toward passivity.
principles.confidence: low empirical confidence; provisional support within this synthetic batch

principles.principle: Follow the concrete thread the buyer supplies; alternate useful statements, answers and questions rather than expanding into a diagnostic checklist.
principles.exceptions: A broader question can be useful when the actual context calls for it.
principles.confidence: low empirical confidence; provisional support within this synthetic batch

principles.principle: Match the next action to the evidence and buyer permission: a scoped conversation, written follow-up, referral or clean exit can each be appropriate. Once agreed, finish naturally.
principles.exceptions: Conditional permission is not a booked meeting. Referral evidence comes from only one example.
principles.confidence: low empirical confidence; provisional support within this synthetic batch

principles.principle: Understand what resistance is about before choosing an answer, hypothesis, question or exit; an installed product and an email request carry context, not a universal rebuttal.
principles.exceptions: Email may be interest, a boundary or dismissal; do not assume one or make contact-detail collection mandatory.
principles.confidence: low empirical confidence; provisional support within this synthetic batch
